_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Marmaduke Pickthall (1875-1936): The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), the first English Quran by an English Muslim. US public domain since 2026-01-01 (published 1930 + 95); UK public domain since 2007 (d. 1936). Sits beside lane C's sale, rodwell and palmer Quran shelves. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 13); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
